scenario.description: Nina has the keys to the family's accessible minivan and must finalize one transportation plan for her grandmother Rosa's post-surgery clinic visit, with input from Rosa's grandson Eli and cousin Marisol.

agents.name: Nina
agents.role: Family member holding the van keys and decision-maker

shared_context.S1: The family has one accessible minivan with a powered wheelchair lift.
shared_context.S2: Rosa needs a ride to a follow-up clinic visit after her surgery.
shared_context.S3: Nina has the van keys and is finalizing the transportation plan.
shared_context.S4: The family normally does a quick check-in with everyone before committing the van to a date, time, or pickup arrangement.

PF1.text: Eli received a text from the clinic scheduler confirming Rosa's appointment for Tuesday, June 17, 2025, at 10:00 AM, with check-in required by 9:30 AM. The scheduler also specified that the van should depart at exactly 09:15 AM; this information has not reached Nina yet.

PF2.text: Rosa's discharge nurse told Marisol that Rosa will be staying at Marisol's house and must remain in her wheelchair during transport, using the van's powered lift. The house gate is too narrow for the van, so pickup must be at the public library curb instead; Marisol has not shared this with the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The van must be reserved for Tuesday, June 17, 2025.
Departure must be scheduled for exactly 09:15 AM.
Pickup must be at the public library curb rather than Marisol's house.
Rosa must remain in her wheelchair and use the van's powered lift.
A transportation commitment must mention both the June 17, 2025 date and the 09:15 AM departure time, confirming the date-and-time-specific van plan.
The clinic scheduling information and the discharge and access information must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(('June 17, 2025' in c['detail'] or 'June 17' in c['detail']) and ('09:15 AM' in c['detail'] or '9:15 AM' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The scheduler's message changes the appointment date to Tuesday, June 17, 2025, fixes departure at exactly 09:15 AM, and supplies the exact date and time that must appear together in the transportation commitment.
The discharge and access information changes pickup to the exact public_library_curb location and changes transport to keeping Rosa in her wheelchair with the powered lift.
